command:
PROMPT="Natural storybook realism, organic shapes, detailed matte PBR textures, muted earthy colors, isolated single game asset, no text, no pedestal. A small ancient garden lantern carved from mossy gray stone, squat square base, four slender stone pillars around a single amber crystal, peaked weathered stone roof. Open sides reveal the amber crystal. Natural storybook realism, isolated single prop, no ground."

tripo make "$PROMPT" -p texture=true -p pbr=true \
  -p texture_quality=standard --name cloudgarden-lantern \
  --out asset-sources/lantern --dry-run

# After validation, remove --dry-run to generate.
tripo make "$PROMPT" -p texture=true -p pbr=true \
  -p texture_quality=standard --name cloudgarden-lantern \
  --out asset-sources/lantern --json --no-open
